name: subscriber_id
description: Unique identifier assigned to the prepaid subscriber

name: subscriber_msisdn
description: Indian prepaid subscriber mobile number in E.164 format

name: account_id
description: Unique prepaid account identifier associated with the subscriber

name: subscriber_segment
description: Customer classification based on recharge and value behaviour

name: wallet_currency
description: Currency used for subscriber balance and top-up transactions

name: subscriber_tenure_days
description: Number of days since subscriber activation

name: days_since_last_recharge
description: Number of calendar days since the subscriber's previous recharge

name: recharge_count_30d
description: Number of successful recharge transactions during the previous 30 days

name: recharge_count_90d
description: Number of successful recharge transactions during the previous 90 days

name: avg_recharge_amount_90d
description: Average INR value of successful recharge transactions during the previous 90 days

name: total_recharge_amount_90d
description: Total INR amount recharged during the previous 90 days

name: low_balance_trigger_count_30d
description: Number of low-balance threshold breaches experienced during the previous 30 days

name: active_days_30d
description: Number of days on which the subscriber generated qualifying service usage during the previous 30 days

name: data_usage_mb_30d
description: Total mobile data consumed during the previous 30 days in MB

name: usage_trend_30d
description: Direction of recent usage behaviour

name: low_balance_threshold_amt
description: Monetary INR balance threshold at which the low-balance journey is triggered

name: balance_before
description: Subscriber balance when the low-balance threshold condition is reached

name: trigger_event_id
description: Unique identifier for the low-balance trigger event

name: event_timestamp
description: Timestamp when the low-balance threshold breach is detected

name: trigger_type
description: Type of event initiating the journey

name: nba_offer_id
description: Identifier of the relevant INR top-up offer presented to the subscriber

name: recommended_topup_amt
description: INR amount recommended to the subscriber for the top-up

name: outreach_channel
description: Channel through which the top-up offer is presented

name: notification_dispatch_ts
description: Timestamp when the top-up notification is dispatched

name: channel_delivery_status
description: Delivery status of the top-up notification

name: customer_action
description: Customer response to the presented top-up offer

name: customer_response_ts
description: Timestamp when the customer accepts or engages with the top-up offer

name: recharge_channel
description: Channel used by the customer to execute the top-up

name: payment_method
description: Payment method used to complete the INR top-up

name: recharge_amount
description: INR amount actually submitted for the top-up

name: recharge_transaction_id
description: Unique identifier for the top-up transaction used for transaction traceability

name: transaction_status
description: Final status of the top-up transaction

name: recharge_completion_ts
description: Timestamp when the successful top-up is completed

name: balance_after
description: Subscriber balance after successful top-up

name: journey_state_final
description: Final state of the Low Balance & Top-Up journey

name: journey_duration_seconds
description: Total elapsed time from low-balance trigger to successful top-up completion
